responsibility: Maintains foundational register metadata and the regscan pass for RTL functions. It initializes target hard-register sets, classes, names, allocation order, and call-used/fixed/global-register state; scans RTL to collect pseudo-register reference information; provides class subset/intersection helpers; and computes/records valid hard-register choices for pseudo subregs via simplifiable-subreg analysis and per-regno mode-change restrictions. This file is GCC’s core register-information infrastructure rather than an allocator pass.
